title: ToggleValue Type from connectToggleRefinement no longer exists
body:
## 🐛 Bug description
I switched from the experimental Typescript version back to the mainstream version after typings were released in the main version and now I am no long able to `import type { ToggleValue } from 'instantsearch.js/es/connectors/toggle-refinement/connectToggleRefinement';` because it doesn't exist as seen in the screenshot below showing connectToggleRefinement.d.ts.

## 🖥 Screenshot
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7559478/130681882-9b656330-2c9a-4070-9b6d-22843649e581.png)

## Environment
"instantsearch.js": "4.28.0",

comments.body:
I haven't yet checked what the exact type ToggleValue used to be, but I assume it's meant to be `ToggleRefinementValue`

EDIT: based on the diff, I'm sure it was renamed in an earlier version ~4.22.0 https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/commit/b9c884daa406e1be63482ed198674b2ba22e66f2#diff-64036b58e6ddbcafec2331581e245e82958ed8a76e9b6b67d6613cab60bed9f5L45-R84
Here's the Type I was using: https://www.runpkg.com/?instantsearch.js@4.12.0-experimental-typescript.0/es/connectors/toggle-refinement/connectToggleRefinement.d.ts#74

Ah I misread, that's now actually `ToggleRefinementRenderState['value']` and doesn't have its own type https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/commit/b9c884daa406e1be63482ed198674b2ba22e66f2#diff-64036b58e6ddbcafec2331581e245e82958ed8a76e9b6b67d6613cab60bed9f5R102-R108
I'll close this issue now, but if you miss other values from experimental, don't hesitate to create a new issue
